name: Note to William

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer in Elwynn Forest, you may help local farming families with personal troubles while the guards focus on military threats.
As a human in Elwynn, you see how the Stonefield and Maclure feud divides neighbors. Sympathetic elders rely on discreet couriers.

faq.answer: William Pestle is an alchemist and apothecary at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. He has known Gramma Mildred Stonefield for many years and makes herbal remedies and specialized draughts.
Gramma Mildred Stonefield wrote the note and sent it to William Pestle. She hopes he can find a way to help Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield.
faq.q: Who sent the note to William?

aliases: why help maybell and tommy joe
faq.answer: Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield love each other, but their families are locked in a bitter rivalry that has lasted for years. Gramma Stonefield hopes William Pestle can find a potion or plan to help them be together despite that hostility.
faq.q: Why are Maybell and Tommy Joe unable to be together openly?

faq.answer: William Pestle stays at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, a town in Elwynn Forest.
faq.q: Where can William Pestle be found?

aliases: what is gramma stonefield first name
faq.answer: Her first name is Mildred. William Pestle says he has not seen Mildred in years when he receives her letter.
faq.q: What is Gramma Stonefield's real name?

aliases: what does william do with note
faq.answer: William says he has not seen Mildred in years, then wonders what her note has to say. She hopes his alchemical craft can help the young lovers.
faq.q: How does William Pestle react to the note?

sections.body: Tommy Joe Stonefield and Maybell Maclure hide their love from their feuding families. The Stonefields and Maclures have lived as neighbors in southern Elwynn Forest for years. Yet their bitter rivalry makes even ordinary relations difficult. Gramma Mildred Stonefield pities the young lovers and seeks another way to bring them together.
sections.title: Star-Crossed in Elwynn

sections.body: Mildred sends a courier north to the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, where William Pestle works as an alchemist and apothecary. She has known him for many years, and believes persuasion alone cannot sway the feuding families. Her message asks for his help. When William receives it, Maybell and Tommy Joe's plight moves him, and he resolves to use his alchemical knowledge on their behalf.
sections.title: An Appeal to Goldshire

summary: In southern Elwynn, Mildred asks William Pestle to help two young lovers. Her note travels to the apothecary in Goldshire, where she hopes he can help Maybell and Tommy Joe unite despite their families’ feud.
